newsitem.title: UK: NMT Group sets premium on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: NMT Group sets premium on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in medical device manufacturer NMT Group Plc jumped to a 4-1/2p premium on Thursday in their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
NMT shares, issued at 50p, were quoted at 54-1/2p by 0806 GMT. Dealers said they had seen buyers of the stock and estimated volume was over 100,000 shares.
The company manufactures retractable hypodermic syringes that could potentially reduce the possibility of medical staff contracting AIDS from infected patients.
"This is an interesting company, especially with all the worry about AIDS," said one dealer.
"At this price, the shares should suit private investors and there is a good chance NMT could be bought up in the next couple of years by a larger company."
